observations.body: Peter places sinning angels in Tartarus awaiting judgment, then contrasts arrogant slander with greater angels who do not bring abusive condemnation before the Lord.

payload.posture: Read “Angels who sinned are confined while greater angels restrain accusation” as its own Scripture scene before carrying its imagery into another heavenly gathering.
payload.tension: the passage shows angelic sin, confinement, judgment, relative power, and restrained accusation, while the passage does not identify the angels’ sin beyond its own wording or supply the complete sequence later interpreters may infer.
